# Sources this skill cites

Each entry gives the exact quote relied on and the date it was checked. If a **Re-check by** date has passed, or the rule is an SBA rule, tell the user it may have changed and to confirm the current version (for SBA rules, the current SOP 50 10 and their lender).

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-qoe-cash-proof

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15: QoE cash proof, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** An SBA-required QoE must include a cash proof that reconciles bank statements to the income statement and tax returns, for the trailing 12 months and the last two fiscal years.
- **Quote:** "The QoE must include a Cash Proof. For purposes of this requirement, a Cash Proof is a financial analysis that reconstructs cash receipts and disbursements by reconciling bank statement data to the income statement and tax return for each period under review. The Cash Proof is designed to identify discrepancies in income and undisclosed expenses and must be performed on both a trailing 12-month basis and the last two fiscal years."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-qoe-not-for-seller

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15: QoE performed for the lender, not the seller, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** An SBA-required quality of earnings report must be independent, done for the lender, and not prepared by or for the seller.
- **Quote:** "The QoE must be performed by an independent, experienced financial professional and must be conducted for the benefit of the Lender. As the QoE report is part of the financial due diligence of the transaction, the report must not be prepared by or for the seller."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-seller-tax-verification

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Section A, Ch. 5: verifying the seller’s tax data, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** In a change of ownership the lender must verify the seller's financial data against IRS records.
- **Quote:** "For a change of ownership, the SBA Lender must verify the seller’s financial data, including a selling sole proprietor’s Schedule C."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-transcript-follow-up

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Section A, Ch. 5: IRS transcript follow-up, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** Lenders request tax transcripts with IRS Form 4506-C or 8821 and must follow up if the IRS hasn't responded within 10 business days.
- **Quote:** "If the SBA Lender does not receive a response from the IRS or the copy of the tax transcript within 10 business days, the SBA Lender must follow up with the IRS to obtain and verify the tax data by resubmitting a copy of IRS Form 4506-C or IRS Form 8821 to IRS with the notation “Second Request” in the top right-hand side."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26
